HOW PROGRESS COMPOUNDS

Each advance leaves tools behind.

01 / SHARED INFRASTRUCTURE

AlphaFold → antimicrobial investigation

In October 2026, Antigravity used AlphaFold Database structures alongside protein annotations and genomic context to investigate an antimicrobial candidate. Wet-lab validation is pending.

Follow the source ↗
02 / TOOLS CROSS DISCIPLINES

Physics → exact quantitative science

BootLoops describes a growing toolkit: methods from particle physics transfer to Bayesian calculations, and each project contributes improved tools.

Explore BootLoops ↗

Earlier results → further arguments

OpenAI reports that some outputs in its mathematics collection build on earlier model-produced results. Verification varies across the collection.

ABOUT THIS COLLECTION

Wonder, with receipts.

This atlas follows selected milestones in AI-assisted science. Dates mark the linked publication or announcement, not necessarily the first experiment.

Branches are subject categories, not claims of causation. Leaves have equal weight: their size is not a score of importance. Source descriptions and limitations accompany every entry.

The collection covers 2020–2026 and is not comprehensive. New findings require editorial review before publication. Last editorial review: October 16, 2026.

Built for Tom Harwood’s Intelligence Explosion project.
